title: Methods in Computational Neuroscience
about: Marine Biological Laboratory advanced research training course in Woods Hole, Massachusetts: Methods in Computational Neuroscience. The 2027 course runs July 24 to August 21, 2027; the application deadline is 10 March 2027.
